title: Vanilla Reloaded
description: Balanced Vanilla+ modpack designed to enhance-not replace-the original Minecraft feel. It combines optimization mods, visual upgrades, and essential QoL improvements to deliver a smoother, cleaner, and more enjoyable experience.
body:
![Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0d7ba5195864bbf288d41dae94cb831130426d40.png)

---

A refined Vanilla+ modpack focused on **high performance**, **modern visuals**, and **useful client-side features**-without changing the core gameplay.

---

## ⚡ Performance

Vanilla Reloaded is heavily optimized using modern performance mods:

- **Sodium**, **Lithium**, **FerriteCore**, **ModernFix**  
- **C2ME**, **VMP**, **Krypton** for better world loading and networking  
- **ImmediatelyFast**, **MoreCulling**, **EntityCulling**

**What you get:**
- Higher FPS  
- Faster chunk loading  
- Reduced RAM usage  
- Smooth and stable gameplay  

---

## 🎨 Visual Enhancements

Vanilla Reloaded enhances visuals while staying true to Minecraft’s style:

- Shader support via **Iris**  
- Dynamic lighting (**LambDynamicLights**)  
- Better skies, clouds, and atmosphere  
- Improved entity models & textures (**EMF / ETF**, **3D Skin Layers**)  
- Rich particles and environmental effects  

### Included Resource Packs

- **Fresh Animations**  
- **Fresh Flowers & Plants**  
- **Fresh Paintings**  
- **Fresh Music Discs**  
- **Default Dark Mode + Expansion**  
- **Refined Torches & Refined Buckets**  
- **Simple Grass Flowers**  
- **Cubic Sun & Moon**  
- **Armor Stands Reimagined**  
- **Icons Pack**

These packs improve:
- Animations  
- UI readability  
- World details  
- Overall visual consistency  

---

## 🧩 Quality of Life

A wide range of QoL improvements:

- UI & HUD improvements (**BetterF3**, **Better Stats**, **AppleSkin**)  
- Inventory tweaks (**Mouse Tweaks**, **Shulker Tooltip**)  
- Chat improvements (**Chat Heads**, **Compact Chat**, **More Chat History**)  
- Controls & accessibility (**Controlling**, **Controlify**)  

Everything is designed to feel **natural and unobtrusive**.

---

## 🗺️ Utility & Tools

Useful client-side tools included:

- **Xaero’s Minimap & World Map**  
- **Litematica** (schematics & building)  
- **Zoomify** (smooth zoom)  
- **Bobby** (extended render distance)  

---

## 🔊 Audio & Immersion

- **Sound Physics Remastered** for realistic audio  
- Improved ambient sounds  
- Optional voice chat via **Plasmo Voice**

---

## 🌍 Vanilla-Friendly

✔ No major content mods  
✔ Works on most vanilla servers  
✔ Fully compatible with existing worlds  

This is still vanilla Minecraft, just **reloaded**.

---

## 🧱 Built on Fabric

- Lightweight and fast  
- Frequently updated  
- Easy to expand  

---

## 🔄 Stability & Reliability

- **Not Enough Crashes**, **Debugify**  
- Improved error handling  
- Designed for long-term survival  

---

## ❓ FAQ

**Q: Can I use shaders?**  
A: Yes, Iris is included.

**Q: Can I add mods?**  
A: Yes, the pack is expandable.

**Q: Do I need this on a server?**  
A: No. Works on vanilla-compatible servers.
